versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked (extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json version); pageSpecVersion is machine-checked against the schema const. repositoryVersion is a documentation-only, hand-maintained marker that nothing checks.

source.name: Cadmus marketing site, local personal clone
source.measuredAgainst: the running clone (headless Chromium, 1440 / 768 / 390); live-site evidence comes from the project's own spec files; no live-site capture was available

sourceStack: documentation-only: React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind CSS v3 + GSAP/ScrollTrigger + sal.js + Lenis + react-router 6 (package.json); the original is a Gatsby site backed by a headless CMS (CLONE_SPEC.md). Never used for token names, section ids, schema fields or validator logic.

constraints.realCompany: Cadmus is a real, live company. This repo describes a local, personal clone built for study. It does not license any of the source's brand, copy, people or media.
constraints.copy: The clone carries real marketing copy on its main pages and real titles/excerpts/authors in its listing data; article and policy bodies are neutral placeholder text. This repo stores NEITHER: copy is recorded as budgets (words, characters, rendered lines, list sizes) and as one-way hashes used only to detect reuse.
constraints.assets: The clone's public/assets holds the real wordmark, real university logos, real third-party integration logos, photographs of real people, stock photographs, real product screenshots and videos. Generated pages may not reproduce or imitate any of them (assets/asset-roles.json, pinned in code).
constraints.forms: The clone's forms never submit: the contact and report forms validate natively and show a local thank-you overlay. Two live third-party endpoints exist as plain links (a webinar registration form and job-application links); link.live-endpoint is forbidden in every mode and reference examples replace them with #.
constraints.embeds: Video embeds are third-party hosted and domain-restricted (role media.third-party-embed, blocked for generation).
constraints.placeholderBodies: Article, case-study, guide and policy bodies in the clone are neutral placeholder text sized to the live line counts, plus a clone-only link to the original page (article.original-link, reference-only).
constraints.fallback: Unknown paths render a not-found body inside the shell (template.not-built-fallback): documentation of a state, never a page to generate.
constraints.publishing: Do not publish this repo, the clone or any page derived from it, and do not make any repository holding them public.

delivery: Clone: clean install with the lockfile (npm ci) in the project root; never ship node_modules or dist. This folder: python3 + jsonschema (pip install jsonschema); stdlib otherwise; Node + a Playwright install only for the optional extraction/measure_sections.mjs.
